summary: Adlai Nortye Group Ltd., a clinical-stage biotech, furnished a Form 6-K with a press release announcing clinical progress: first patient dosed in Australia for AN4035, a CEACAM5-targeting ADC with pan-RAS(ON) inhibitor payload, and U.S. FDA IND clearance via Study-May-Proceed letter. Primary endpoint is safety/tolerability in a global Phase I trial; full Phase Ia data expected H2 2027. No transaction, board action, or corporate structural change is involved. The filing is a routine operational update on drug development, not a special situation, so no deal terms exist. Watch for future clinical data readouts and NMPA IND filing status.
